opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with followers, top repo stats and latest post, then discard.
steps: Click global search and type the GitHub username, press Enter
Note followers and open top repo to read stars and language
Open mail compose and enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person + Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view a domain's Wayback Machine snapshot for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia and press Enter
Open Wayback Machine, enter the domain, press Enter
Choose the year and a snapshot day
Read the headline text of the archived page
Open notes, create a new note with person summary and domain/year headline, press Enter
